criteria.criterion: Measure dated compatible station candidates for existing countries and propose additional countries with evidence and explicit coverage gaps.
criteria.evidence: Fresh scans completed for all 16 countries and counted US 11, FR 5, JP 2, GB 6, CA 3, DE 1, ES 1, IT 8, AU 1, BR 1, MX 1, KR 1, IN 1, ZA 2, NL 1, SE 1; all exact provider tuples matched. However, the SE tuple for Bandit Classic Rock (UUID 40dfa430-7988-4b02-ae1b-ce5fe8b5aad3; https://wr11-ice.stream.khz.se/wr11_mp3) failed the fresh direct check with HTTP 500/no bytes and remains admitted in the catalog. The measured evidence therefore identifies an explicit coverage gap that the current candidate set has not excluded; this criterion is FAIL pending the spec-required removal/revision through Implement and Review. Existing-country drift vs DIAL-008 2026-11-12 03:43Z counts is +1 for each of the eight existing countries. No replacement URL was tested.
criteria.method: Fresh bounded live scans via built dist/discovery.js over all 16 fixed countries; recorded each scan’s three window outcomes and exact candidate UUID/country/codec/url row match. Compared existing-country counts with the recorded DIAL-008 2026-11-12 03:43 UTC observation.

criteria.criterion: Investigate official NTS Radio channels, stream compatibility, attribution and country versus editorial identity; propose clean discoverability without misleading location labels.
criteria.evidence: Approved spec identifies NTS 1/2 as editorial channels, cites official support/live links and keeps them country-free. UI renders NTS 1 and NTS 2 with official NTS links and an honest “In-player listening is unavailable” state; selecting NTS disables Play, hides Radio Browser disclosure and makes no Radio Browser click call. Tests assert this isolation. No NTS audio URL was enabled or substituted.
criteria.method: Reviewed approved PRODUCT/TECH and NTS UI source/tests on the candidate; full `npm test` exercises NTS behavior.

criteria.criterion: Independent Review and Verify must separate catalog admission, stream reachability and actual ChatGPT playback evidence for any implemented candidate.

Catalog and direct probe results are reported separately from actual ChatGPT host CSP/audio/layout, which are explicitly BLOCKED because no host session/evidence was available.

spec_acceptance.criterion: The 16-country picker and country tool expose the researched countries, with exact-country MP3 results only. The 16 candidate UUID/URL pairs are admitted only while their current provider rows still match the fixed policy. For each country, fresh evidence records directory presence, exclusion, count, and any drift; missing pairs are explicit gaps.
spec_acceptance.evidence: The 16-country picker codes and country tool are present; all 16 scans were complete, every current row matched its fixed tuple, and all 16 appeared in results. Current counts and drift are in evidence JSON. No missing pair, URL substitution, or broad origin admission was observed.
spec_acceptance.method: Freshly scanned all 16 picker countries and compared each current provider row to the fixed UUID/country/MP3/exact-url tuple; recorded counts and existing-country drift.

spec_acceptance.criterion: A fresh independent direct probe for each admitted pair records status, content type, redirect behavior and capped MP3 bytes. A direct probe is not called ChatGPT playback. Changes to any URL/origin require new spec approval, not an automatic substitution.
spec_acceptance.evidence: All 16 admitted pairs were probed. Fifteen returned 200/206, audio/mpeg, 256 bytes, and MPEG frame sync; none redirected. The SE pair Bandit Classic Rock (UUID 40dfa430-7988-4b02-ae1b-ce5fe8b5aad3; https://wr11-ice.stream.khz.se/wr11_mp3) returned HTTP 500, no content type, no bytes, and no redirect. The same exact provider tuple remains admitted in the fresh SE catalog result (`admitted: true`). This conflicts with the approved spec’s no-quiet-substitution/failed-candidate exclusion gate. Evidence supports routing this pair back through Implement and fresh Review/Verify; no replacement URL was tried.
spec_acceptance.method: For every currently admitted pair, sent one GET with Range bytes=0-255, `redirect: manual`, 8-second abort and read cap of 256 bytes. Recorded status/content-type/location/bytes and MPEG frame sync.

spec_acceptance.criterion: Country scans preserve the DIAL-008 limits, 8-item local reveal, known-choice More, partial/manual Retry, stale-result guards, safe text, selection/audio continuity, exact CSP, signed click reporting and its disclosure.
spec_acceptance.evidence: `npm test` passes 38/38. Coverage includes exact 16-pair gating, DIAL-008 bounded three-window collector, 30 cap, local More/retry, stale guards, safe browser catalog, source switching and playback coordination. This attempt changed only player/server request-correlation and tests; latest Review confirms CSP/media policy unchanged. Real host CSP remains unverified.
spec_acceptance.method: Ran full suite on exact candidate; reviewed the accepted Review report and changed-file list for DIAL-008 policy/CSP changes.

spec_acceptance.criterion: NTS 1 and NTS 2 are plainly discoverable as NTS editorial channels with the official link and no country claim. In-player controls are enabled only after the narrow compatibility gate passes. Otherwise both official links and an honest unavailable state work. NTS plays never report a Radio Browser click.
spec_acceptance.evidence: NTS 1/2 appear in a distinct editorial collection with official NTS links and no country labels. The unresolved compatibility gate is implemented as link-only: NTS selection disables Play, displays unavailable status, hides Radio Browser attribution and emits no Radio Browser click tool call; UI test confirms the call count does not change.
spec_acceptance.method: Inspected public/discovery.html and src/player.ts; full UI harness assertions cover NTS switching.

spec_acceptance.criterion: The player is compact, keyboard accessible, usable at narrow and desktop widths in light/dark host themes, and has clear Play/Pause and failure states. Independent Review and Verify bind to the exact candidate commit. Verify records catalog admission, direct reachability, CSP, and actual ChatGPT audio separately; absent host playback or layout evidence is BLOCKED, never inferred from unit tests.
spec_acceptance.evidence: Local markup/tests exercise semantic tabs, keyboard tab navigation, 44px link targets and explicit Play/Pause/error states, but no ChatGPT host UI session was available for narrow/desktop light/dark layout, actual audio, CSP, Pause/resume, or audible continuity. Those host checks cannot be inferred from unit tests or direct MP3 bytes.
spec_acceptance.method: Reviewed responsive/keyboard markup and automated tests; searched for actual ChatGPT host playback/CSP/layout evidence in this run.
